messages:
Nina Gomez: Heads up 1 I submitted my resignation today, last day is 2025-02-14. Need confirmation on: COBRA enrollment window and when coverage actually stops, final pay date (incl. accrued PTO), laptop return options (mail vs drop-off), and how to opt into the exit interview. cc @People Ops
People Ops: Thanks for the heads up Nina. Quick answers: 
• COBRA: vendor sends packet within 7 business days of separation. Company coverage runs through your termination date (2025-02-14). If you elect COBRA, coverage is retroactive to the day after termination.
• Final pay: payroll processes final wages + unused PTO in the next regular payroll run (target 2025-02-28). If you need expedited pay, let us know and we can request an off-cycle with payroll (may take up to 3 business days).
• Laptop: two options: HQ dropbox or pre-paid mail label from IT portal. If mailing, package securely and include printed asset tag.
• Exit interview: we always offer a voluntary 30-min call. Reply with preferred times and People Ops will send an invite + short questionnaire.
Nina Gomez: Prefer mail label 1 will I get unemployment paperwork or other separation docs?
PayrollBot: Separation paperwork: final pay stub will be emailed after payroll processes. Unemployment forms vary by state; we provide the employer separation date on request. W-2 will be issued in the usual cycle.
IT-Bot: Asset return steps: use https://redwood-internal/it/returns  choose "Mail Device" to request a pre-paid label. Include `asset_tag` and `serial` in the form. Default deprovision schedule: SSO & console access disabled at 6pm local time on termination date unless your manager requests an extension for handover. If you need an access bridge for handoff, have your manager open an IT ticket with target window and justification.
Chris Park: Nina 1 if you want, I can grab the device from you before you mail it and drop it at HQ for faster processing.
Nina Gomez: Thanks Chris 1 I'll request the mail label but DM you in case we change plans. For COBRA, is dental & vision included?
People Ops: COBRA applies to medical, dental, and vision plans you were enrolled in. The packet details premiums, payment schedule, and deadlines. Reminder: you have 60 days from the date the COBRA packet was sent to elect coverage.
Nina Gomez: Good to know. Please schedule the exit interview 1 Tue 2025-02-18 or Wed 2025-02-19 mornings work.
People Ops: Booked exit interview with People Ops rep on Tue 2025-02-18 09:30-10:00 PT. Calendar invite & short questionnaire sent. Checklist summary for Nina: 
• COBRA packet emailed within 7 business days
• Coverage ends 2025-02-14; COBRA retroactive to 2025-02-15 if elected
• Final pay targeted 2025-02-28; submit expenses by 2025-02-10
• Asset return: requested mail label via IT portal (or Chris will drop at HQ)
• Access deprovision scheduled 2025-02-14 18:00 local time (exceptions via IT ticket)
Nina Gomez: Thanks all 1 I'll fill out the questionnaire and submit any expense receipts today.
